title: Just Helping recycled 88,544 Xmas trees in 2026 and raised a record £1,885,915 for local UK causes
summary_full: A charitable organization in the UK has triumphantly gathered 88,544 discarded Christmas trees, turning them into valuable products. This initiative raised £1.88 million for various local charities, breaking past records. The substantial involvement of volunteers during the collection phase contributed greatly, while the campaign fostered significant environmental progress by curbing carbon emissions. The charity envisions expanding its recycling efforts to cover more regions in the future.
